test_reflection_scalar_constructor: test the protobuf reflection module by constructing messages with scalar field keyword arguments
test_reflection_repeated_fields: test the protobuf reflection module by constructing messages with repeated scalar and composite fields
test_reflection_has_field: test the protobuf reflection HasField method to check if optional fields are set on a message
test_reflection_extensions: test the protobuf reflection Extensions dict to set and get extension fields on a message
test_reflection_merge_copy: test the protobuf reflection MergeFrom and CopyFrom methods to merge or copy fields between messages
